correctness.rationale: Direct subtraction yields [W_n,W_m]=(m-n)W_(n+m) for every q,lambda. Any product isomorphism is a Witt Lie automorphism; Bavula classifies these as Phi_(eps,a)(W_n)=eps*a^n W_(eps n). Comparing coefficients in eps*qprime*(lambda+m+(1-q)*n)=q*(mu+eps*m+eps*(1-qprime)*n), coefficient of m implies qprime=q, constant mu=eps*lambda; n coefficient then agrees, and explicit Phi maps give converse. eps reflection stabilizes lambda only at lambda=0; composition acts by a↦a^(-1). Independent symbolic coefficient calculation reproduced all three coefficients. Requires full complex Witt automorphism theorem, not merely its subset.
